input_signal: Per-time-step RMS sqrt(mean(x^2,y^2,z^2)) separately for acceleration and gyroscope; center crop original indices [2:198] to 196 samples; 49 non-overlapping 4-sample patches.

image.pixel_mapping: tanh output [-1,1] -> round(127.5*(z+1)) -> uint8; fixed mapping, no per-image rescaling

image_format: WebP lossless RGB; no private metadata
out_of_range: Fixed tanh [-1,1] to uint8 mapping; no adaptive contrast/stretching; numerical range and pixel hashes logged
supervision_note: Image converter and ViT were supervised on original training labels; Qwen receives no examples and no training updates.
